description: End-to-end codebase health workflow: discover architecture, review it, fix issues with TDD, and document the result. Chains describe-design, architecture review skills, and tdd-ai into a single phased workflow with checkpoint documents. Use this skill whenever the user says "audit my codebase", "do a full architecture review and fix things", "improve my codebase architecture", "health check this project", "review and refactor", "clean up this codebase", or any request that involves understanding an existing codebase, identifying architectural problems, fixing them, and documenting the result. Also trigger when the user wants a comprehensive codebase improvement that goes beyond a single review — they want the full loop of discover, diagnose, fix, and re-document. If the user seems to want both a review AND fixes applied, this is the right skill.
